verifyNotes: Confirm length (2 hours), 50–60 multiple choice/select items, fee $200, languages, and sections/weights against the official exam page cloud.google.com/learn/certification/machine-learning-engineer and the current exam guide (v3.1 PDF). Google does not publish a passing score. Use current names (Vertex AI, Vertex AI Agent Builder / Vertex AI Search, Model Garden, Vertex AI Pipelines, Feature Store, Model Monitoring, BigQuery ML, Gemini on Vertex AI, Gen AI evaluation service). If Google has renamed a product (e.g. Agent Builder to Gemini Enterprise / Agent Platform), teach the current name and mention the exam guide name. Never copy official sample questions.
name: Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer
audience: ML engineers with 3+ years of industry experience, 1+ on Google Cloud
format: 50–60 multiple choice and multiple select items in 2 hours; online or test-centre proctored; English and Japanese. Google does not publish a passing score; this site uses 720 on a 100–1000 scale for its mocks, as for GAIL.
scenarios: Medical imaging classifier under privacy rules
